name: Healthy Working Life Community Grants Programme
whoFor: Economically inactive Kirklees residents, reached through voluntary and community organisations funded by the programme. Grants go to VCSE and grassroots organisations, not individuals.
eligibility: Economically inactive residents, particularly those with health conditions or disabilities, and other priority groups
exclusions: People who are in work or actively seeking work
referralRoutes: Delivery is by funded VCSE and grassroots organisations; participant access routes will be confirmed once grants are awarded

selfReferral.note: To be confirmed following grant awards

projects.name: Community grants to VCSE and grassroots organisations
projects.overview: Grants of 3,000 to 10,000 pounds for single organisations and up to 20,000 pounds for joint applications, funding community-based pre-employment and wellbeing activity. Organisations must be registered on the Kirklees Grant Access Point.
where: Community settings across Kirklees - hyperlocal delivery by VCSE and grassroots organisations
projects.duration: Projects start by 1 October 2026 at the latest

workExperience: Yes - where offered by funded projects
notes: Status before November 2026: Future - not yet open to referrals. Grants awarded; no information on individual grant-funded schemes until awards are confirmed

provenance.source: Kirklees HWL Pathways Aug 26 v2.1 (draft 15 Sept 2026; grant-funded schemes added 12 Oct 2026)

listing.reason: Healthy Working Life scheme, on the live list from the start.
